title: Ferroptosis regulator NOX1 acts a diagnostic biomarker and mediates disease progression with the transcriptional regulation of STAT3 in glaucoma.
authors: Zong, Fangwei; Wang, Xuerui; You, Jiaxin; Wu, Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究STAT3转录因子调控NOX1在青光眼中的作用，虽涉及TF-DNA结合（ChIP验证），但核心是疾病生物标志物与铁死亡机制，非蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: PURPOSE: Primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is the leading cause of irreversible blindness. Regrettably, the roles of ferroptosis-related (FR) genes in POAG remain elusive. DESIGN: Five GEO data sets and a series of experimentations in vitro were used for bioinformatic exploration and biological validation. METHODS: Using multiple machine learning algorithms, four critical FR genes in POAG progression were screened. The clinical value and biological function of NOX1 were comprehensively analyzed using bioinformatic approaches. A POAG in vitro model was constructed using H2O2 treatment. NOX1 effects on the viability of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) and ferroptosis process were determined through CCK8, EdU, ROS detection, and transmission electron microscopy. Its upstream transcriptional mechanisms were determined through dual luciferase assays, and chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP). RESULTS: NOX1 was identified as the critical FR gene in POAG progression and served as an effective diagnostic biomarker. High-NOX1 expression was tightly associated with increased infiltration levels of multiple subtypes of T cells, such as T cells CD8 and T cells CD4. However, the enrichments of eight metabolic gene sets did not differ between the POAG samples with high- and low-NOX1 expression groups. Silencing NOX1 maintained RGC survival and inhibited the ferroptosis process. Mechanistically, STAT3 upregulated NOX1 by binding its promoter region that was located at the 429 th to 419 th bases upstream of the NOX1 transcriptional start site. NOX1 overexpression reversed the inhibitory effects of silencing STAT3 on RGC survival and the ferroptosis process. CONCLUSIONS: NOX1 was a good biomarker for characterizing POAG and promoted POAG progression through STAT3-mediated transcriptionally activation.
abstract_zh: 目的：原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）是导致不可逆性失明的主要原因。遗憾的是，铁死亡相关（FR）基因在POAG中的作用仍不明确。设计：利用五个GEO数据集及一系列体外实验进行生物信息学探索和生物学验证。方法：采用多种机器学习算法，筛选出POAG进展中的四个关键FR基因。通过生物信息学方法全面分析了NOX1的临床价值和生物学功能。使用H2O2处理构建了POAG体外模型。通过CCK8、EdU、ROS检测和透射电子显微镜确定了NOX1对视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）存活及铁死亡过程的影响。其上游转录机制通过双荧光素酶实验和染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）确定。结果：NOX1被确定为POAG进展中的关键FR基因，并作为有效的诊断生物标志物。高NOX1表达与多种T细胞亚型（如CD8 T细胞和CD4 T细胞）的浸润水平增加密切相关。然而，在高和低NOX1表达组的POAG样本之间，八个代谢基因集的富集情况没有差异。沉默NOX1维持了RGC存活并抑制了铁死亡过程。机制上，STAT3通过结合其启动子区域（位于NOX1转录起始位点上游第429至419个碱基处）上调NOX1。NOX1过表达逆转了沉默STAT3对RGC存活和铁死亡过程的抑制作用。结论：NOX1是表征POAG的良好生物标志物，并通过STAT3介导的转录激活促进POAG进展。
